definition: Temporary quarantine metric for extracted formula constants whose canonical metric mapping requires human review.
Measured body mass at a timestamp; raw and trend values are separate metrics.
Filtered body mass estimate; filter and parameters must be versioned.
Change in trend body mass per seven days.
Weekly change divided by an explicit reference mass.
Documented food-energy intake; missing, partial, and confirmed zero are distinct.
Model estimate, not direct calorimetry unless method says so.
Equation-derived BMR with equation ID and inputs.
Daily protein intake with source and completeness.
Proxy requiring intake, exercise expenditure and fat-free mass; not a diagnosis.
Exercise load with equipment and unilateral/bilateral semantics.
Completed or prescribed repetitions per set.
Subjective effort estimate with confidence/calibration.
Scale-specific perceived exertion; scale must be recorded.
Document-specific load x repetitions aggregation; limitations retained.
Direct and indirect set accounting must be separate/versioned.
Equation-derived estimate with exercise and formula ID.
Elapsed or active duration; basis must be explicit.
Measured or device-estimated distance with modality and device.
Time per distance; display units are transformations.
Distance per time.
Device-reported or estimated power with device/calibration.
Heart rate with sampling and device metadata.
Protocol-specific HRV metric; statistic and acquisition conditions required.
Resting heart rate under recorded protocol.
Device or self-report sleep duration with measurement method.
Scale-specific self-report soreness; body region required when relevant.
Structured event, not a single readiness scalar or diagnosis.
Model output only; components, uncertainty, version and missingness required.
Window and load definition required; not an injury-risk threshold by itself.
Window and load definition required.
Versioned completeness/reliability score with explicit components.
